extendInfo.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Anjadhe uses Bluetooth so the in-app browser can sign you in with security keys and passkeys (e.g. iPhone-as-passkey).
extendInfo.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Anjadhe reads this Mac's reminders to import them into Tasks, only when you turn that on in Settings.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Anjadhe reads this Mac's calendars to show their events in the Calendar, only when you turn that on in Settings.
